title: All-complex normalizations of the published etale scalar comparisons
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings in Type (u+1), phi:A→B a unital ring homomorphism, and T a scheme in universe u. The published coefficient-unit comparison unitIso(phi,T) satisfies UnitNormalization(phi,T), and the published tensor comparison tensorIso(phi,T) satisfies TensorNormalization(phi,T), namely the all-complex representative equations of [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations]. These equations hold for arbitrary complexes and require no coefficient flatness or boundedness.

source.place: Tag 07A4; all-complex normalization equations of the published scalar comparisons, extracted from proof step 5 of lem-coef-finite-hom-domain-calculus.

proof.text: The published unitIso is the chosen witness of unitIso_existsUnique. Its choose_spec gives UnitNormalization immediately. The published site tensorIso is heterogeneously equal to the chosen witness of tensorIso_existsUnique, by the choose_spec of siteTensorIso_existsUnique. Both isomorphisms have the same type, so eq_of_heq converts this to equality. Transport the TensorNormalization choose_spec along that equality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4; the normalization choose_spec clauses defining the published scalar unit and tensor comparisons. Isolated only to keep the assigned finite coefficient specialization within the compilation limit.

theorem scalarExtension_normalizations
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    UnitNormalization φ T (unitIso φ T) ∧ TensorNormalization φ T (tensorIso φ T)
